title: This Shark Filters 2,000 Tons of Water Every Hour

scenes.text: This shark filters two thousand tons of water every hour.
It's the basking shark, and it grows up to forty feet long.
Its mouth can open nearly three feet wide.
It swims slowly near the surface, letting water flow through its gills.
Tiny prey get trapped, and the water flows out.

description:
A basking shark can filter about 2,000 tons of water an hour through its gills.
It grows up to 40 feet long and opens its mouth nearly three feet wide to catch tiny prey.
Would you swim next to one?
first_comment: Bonus: a basking shark is harmless to people, it only eats tiny prey. Would you swim next to a 40-foot shark?
